name: Kraken
tagline: Spot and futures cryptocurrency trading and market data API
description: Kraken provides REST and WebSocket APIs for spot and derivatives trading, market data, account balances, order management, and funding operations. Public market endpoints require no authentication; private account and trading endpoints use API key authentication with request signing. Widely used by traders and bots for automated exchange access.

auth.details: Public endpoints need no auth. Private REST endpoints require API-Key and API-Sign headers (HMAC-SHA512 of nonce+POST data with base64-decoded secret), self-serve key creation in account settings.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access included with account; no separate API fee. Trading subject to Kraken fee schedule by volume.
pricing.paid_plans: Volume-based trading fees; no separate API subscription tiers documented.

rate_limits: REST: counter-based (starts ~15, decays over time); private endpoints cost more. Exact counters vary by endpoint; WebSocket has separate limits. See docs for current tables.
use_cases: place and cancel spot orders programmatically
fetch account balances and trade history
stream order book updates via WebSocket
